title: Ruins Master
next_chapter_hook: However, at the critical moment when the master claiming ceremony was completing, the formation outside the ruins suddenly trembled violently - Han Lie had not only come himself, but also brought the elite team from Xuanwu Sect. Their goal was clear: to permanently trap Chen Ji in this ruins before he could complete the master claiming!

text.content: Ling Yuan's laughter echoed in the Mental Sea, yet Chen Ji didn't even furrow his brow. The moment the shadow of Chen Xuan on the fragment dissipated, that venomous voice eagerly rushed out, like a venomous snake that had been hidden for hundreds of years finally finding an exit. "Lost?" Chen Ji sneered in his heart, "Ling Yuan, you haven't even看清 the chessboard I set up, yet dare say such words?" He dismissed that remnant soul's mockery as wind in his ears, turning instead to gaze at the ruins' core before him - that cluster of light that had been dormant for ten thousand years was slowly awakening, emitting pulsations only he could understand.

The light cluster's pulsations were like heartbeats, one, two, three... increasingly urgent, increasingly intense. Chen Ji felt an ancient will examining him, a gaze that transcended time, as if scrutinizing his past, present, and future. "You've finally come." An aged, exhausted voice emerged from the light cluster, "Chen Xuan's heir, I've been waiting for you for a long time." The ruins' core master claiming ceremony officially began.

dialogue.content: "Waiting for me for a long time?" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his expression revealing neither joy nor anger, "I truly kept you waiting, senior. But before we begin, I'd like to ask - is there a time limit for this master claiming ceremony?" His question was casual, yet in his heart he was rapidly calculating. Mo Xiansheng had mentioned that claiming the ruins required the time of half a stick of incense, and during that period, he would be completely exposed.

text.content: The light cluster fell silent for a moment, then answered: "Once begun, it cannot be interrupted. You have half a stick of incense time to prepare, and half a stick of incense time for the claiming. Before the claiming completes, everything about you will be exposed within the ruins - including your enemies." No sooner had the words fallen than countless ancient runes on the ruins' walls suddenly illuminated, forming layers of light curtains that isolated Chen Ji from the outside world. This was not protection, but a declaration - the ruins master's choice would be known to all.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Half a stick of incense of exposure time was enough for all those coveting the ruins to arrive. He had used the Tianji Record to deduce countless possibilities, yet he had overlooked this crucial aspect - or rather, he had deliberately overlooked it. Because he knew someone would definitely not let him complete the task smoothly. "Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji murmured this name, a playful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, "Well played. Using Chen Xuan's resentment to disrupt my mind, then using the master claiming ceremony's rules to set a trap for me. This time, you've actually improved considerably."

choice.prompt: Just as Chen Ji prepared to initiate the master claiming ceremony, the formation outside the ruins suddenly trembled violently. A savage aura was approaching - the visitor meant business, and the strength was alarming. Facing this sudden interference, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Interrupt the claiming and face the enemy
choices.description: Immediately interrupt the master claiming ceremony and deal with the invading enemy first. Though the opportunity would be lost, at least one's life would be preserved.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to claim the ruins, possibly be completely destroyed by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Resolve the current crisis and maintain strategic initiative
choices.risk_hint: Once interrupted, the ruins' core will fall back into slumber, and the opportunity to claim it may be lost forever

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment, interrupting the connection with the light cluster. The light cluster emitted a regretful sigh: "You've made your choice, but the opportunity comes only once." Chen Ji turned to face the ruins' entrance, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes: "No, opportunities have never been limited to just one. I was merely fishing."

choices.description: Ignore the external enemy's interference and forcefully complete the master claiming ceremony. Once successful, you will control the entire ruins, and the invaders will be of no concern.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to act during the claiming process; if interrupted, you will suffer backlash
choices.visible_reward: Control the ruins, strength surges dramatically, permanently gain the ruins' power
choices.risk_hint: If attacked before the claiming completes, you may suffer minor injuries at best, or death and the destruction of your Dao at worst

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and reestablished the connection with the light cluster. "Begin." His voice was calm as still water, "Whatever happens outside, do not stop until I complete the claiming." The light cluster fell silent for a moment, then erupted with dazzling light: "As you wish."

choices.text: Divide forces to face the enemy while continuing the claiming
choices.description: Use the ruins' formations to split off a strand of divine consciousness to face the enemy, while the main body continues the claiming. Fighting on two fronts - risks and rewards intertwined.
choices.visible_cost: Dividing divine consciousness reduces the claiming speed, and injuries may occur when facing the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Balance both fronts; victory brings double rewards, defeat can still buy time
choices.risk_hint: Dividing forces means neither front can give full strength; if the enemy's strength exceeds expectations, it could mean total defeat

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, and a bold plan took shape in his mind. He formed seals with both hands, and the runes on the ruins' walls suddenly blazed to life. Light curtains separated from them, forming a illusory clone. "Go." He commanded his clone, "Tell them what it means to - provoke the untouchable."

At the ruins' entrance, the formation shattered with a thunderous crash. A domineering figure broke through the layers of arrays, charging in with overwhelming momentum. Han Lie! The number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, though covered in blood, had burning battle intent in his eyes. He immediately spotted Chen Ji enveloped in light, and the cluster of light merging with him. "Master claiming the ruins?" Han Lie burst into laughter, "Chen Ji, you think I'll give you this opportunity!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's clone stood before Han Lie, a faint smile on his face: "Young Master Han, long time no see. Is your injury from our last parting healed?" Spoken casually, yet it precisely struck Han Lie's痛处. During their last encounter in the secret realm, he had been trapped by Chen Ji's formations for three full days, finally escaping with his pride shattered. This incident had already spread throughout the three major sects, becoming the greatest humiliation of his life.

"Chen Ji!" Han Lie roared, qi and blood surging around him as Xuanwu True Meaningcrazed凝聚. His cultivation had advanced considerably since their last encounter, clearly having paid an enormous price for revenge. "Today, I'll show you what a true genius is!" Before the words even finished, he threw a punch at Chen Ji's clone, fist wind howling, carrying terrifying power enough to destroy a mountain.

text.content: Chen Ji's clone neither dodged nor evaded, allowing that punch to slam into his body. Yet the anticipated dispersal did not occur - ripples spread across the clone's surface, layer by layer absorbing that terrifying force, channeling it into the floor tiles beneath. "Young Master Han, your strength has grown." Chen Ji's clone said nonchalantly, "Unfortunately, this is the ruins. On my territory, you can't even touch the hem of my clothes." The ruins' formations began to operate, countless light curtains surging from all directions, trapping Han Lie within.

Meanwhile, the ruins' core master claiming ceremony was proceeding at full speed. Chen Ji's main body sat cross-legged within the light cluster, countless ancient memories flooding into his Mental Sea like a tide - Chen Xuan's lifetime of knowledge, his thousands of years of experience traversing the world, his complete wisdom for opposing Heaven's Mandate. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded within the Mental Sea, merging with the light cluster. Chen Ji felt his power rising at a staggering rate: early Transcendence Stage... middle Transcendence Stage... peak Transcendence Stage!

"This... this is impossible!" Han Lie, trapped within the light curtains, watched helplessly as Chen Ji's aura continued to surge. His eyes were filled with disbelief, "How could his cultivation breakthrough two minor realms in such a short time? What kind of cultivation technique is this!" What made him despair even more was that as Chen Ji fused deeper with the ruins, the formations trapping him also strengthened continuously. Every attack he launched was like striking cotton - powerful yet with nowhere to apply force.

choice.prompt: The master claiming ceremony was nearing completion, Chen Ji's power had already broken through to Transcendence Stage Peak. Though Han Lie was trapped, elite disciples from Xuanwu Sect were still approaching from outside. Chen Ji had precious little time remaining - he must make a decision the instant the claiming completed:

choices.text: Release Han Lie and focus on the fusion
choices.description: Ignore Han Lie no more, pour all mental focus into the master claiming ceremony. Once completed, the entire ruins becomes his domain, and Han Lie cannot cause any trouble.
choices.visible_cost: Give Han Lie breathing room, possibly leaving hidden dangers
choices.visible_reward: Ensure the claiming completes smoothly without hidden troubles
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie escapes in time, he will surely become a major threat in the future

text.content: Chen Ji's clone glanced at Han Lie indifferently, then transformed into a stream of light returning to his main body. The light curtains dissipated, restoring Han Lie's freedom, but he felt no joy whatsoever - because he knew it was already too late. Chen Ji's aura had completely merged with the ruins; even if he attacked now, it would only bring humiliation upon himself. "Chen Ji..." Han Lie ground his teeth, "Remember this!"

choices.text: While the claiming completes, instantly kill Han Lie
choices.description: In the instant the claiming completes, utilize the power of the ruins master to deliver a fatal blow to Han Lie. One strike, permanent elimination of future troubles.
choices.visible_cost: Just completed the claiming, divine consciousness is still unstable; forcing an attack may damage the origin
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly resolve Han Lie and deter all covetous onlookers
choices.risk_hint: Forceful attacks may cause flaws in the post-claiming fusion

text.content: The instant the claiming completed, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. His pupils reflected the outline of the entire ruins, and his gaze upon Han Lie was like looking at an ant. "I said before." Chen Ji's voice echoed through the ruins, "On my territory, you can't even touch the hem of my clothes." Before the words even finished, an invisible force descended, pressing Han Lie ruthlessly into the ground.

choices.text: Humiliate Han Lie then release him
choices.description: In the instant the claiming completes, give Han Lie the maximum humiliation, but spare his life. Let the entire world see that Xuanwu Sect's number one prodigy is worthless before him.
choices.visible_cost: Releasing Han Lie may create enemies
choices.visible_reward: Enormous psychological blow, fame shaking the world
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's hatred will reach maximum; he will surely become a dangerous enemy in the future

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly out of the light cluster, behind him the completely fused ruins' core. He looked down at Han Lie pressed to the ground, a playful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. "Young Master Han, you said you'd show me what a genius is?" He flicked a finger lightly, the force trapping Han Lie suddenly intensifying, "Now I'll tell you - before me, you don't even qualify as trash."

The moment the master claiming ceremony completely finished, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of fullness. His divine consciousness had merged completely with the entire ruins; every formation, every restriction, every brick and stone was like an extension of his body. Chen Xuan's lifetime of inheritance belonged entirely to him now. No, it was more than that - the ruins' core had also granted him an unprecedented ability: spatial manipulation. Within this ruins, he could briefly distort space, creating his own domain.

dialogue.content: Han Lie was crushed by that invisible force until his bones creaked and groaned, blood seeping from the corners of his mouth. He struggled desperately, yet like a mayfly trying to shake a tree, it was utterly useless. "Chen Ji! How dare you!" He roared shrilly, "I'm Xuanwu Sect's number one genius! If you kill me, Xuanwu Sect will never let you go!" Hearing this, Chen Ji not only didn't become angry, but laughed instead: "Xuanwu Sect? Young Master Han, do you think I would care?"

text.content: From outside the ruins came bursts of exclamations. The elite disciples of Xuanwu Sect had finally arrived, yet they witnessed their invincible Senior Brother being trampled under someone's foot like a dead dog. That scene brought them far greater shock than Chen Ji's breakthrough to Transcendence Stage Peak. "Senior Brother... lost?" A disciple murmured, his face full of confusion. "Lost, completely and utterly lost." Another disciple said quietly, "He didn't even have the strength to fight back."

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, not giving Han Lie another glance. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his voice echoing through the ruins: "Today's events, I give you one stick of incense time to spread the word. Tell the entire world - Chen Ji, thetrash disciple of Tianqing Sect, has become the new master of these ruins." He paused, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, "Of course, if you wish to seek revenge, I await you at any time." The ruins' formations began to operate, light curtains pushing Han Lie and the others out of the ruins.

The ruins' great doors slowly closed, sealing all outsiders outside. Chen Ji stood alone in the empty hall, feeling the powerful energy surging within him. Transcendence Stage Peak, just one step away from Void Refining Stage. And at this Transcendence Stage level, he was confident in fearing no one. "Ling Yuan." Chen Ji murmured this name, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes, "You sent Han Lie to die - was it to test my strength? Or to use his hand to interrupt my claiming? Whichever it was, you miscalculated."

dialogue.content: At this moment, a familiar phantom emerged from Chen Ji's Brow Center - it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "Well done." Mo Xiansheng rare showed a hint of approval, "Chen Xuan's inheritance has fully merged into your Mental Sea, including all the forbidden techniques and formations he researched throughout his life. From now on, you are the true master of these ruins." He paused, his expression growing grave, "But I must warn you, Ling Yuan will not let this go. Since he dared to act at this time, it means he has recovered sufficient strength. The next volume, your confrontation will officially begin."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, taking Mo Xiansheng's words to heart. He turned to gaze into the depths of the ruins, where countless unexplored forbidden lands still waited, countless hidden secrets lay dormant. But those could be left for later. At this moment, he simply wished to savor this hard-won victory. "Senior Chen Xuan." He silently said in his heart, "Your仇, I will avenge for you. Your unfinished cause, I will complete for you. The secret of the Tianji Record... I will uncover with my own hands." The ruins' light gradually收敛, everything returning to stillness. And beneath this stillness, undercurrents were stirring.

In the final moment of the master claiming's completion, Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. He looked down to see blurry text appearing on the fragment - Chen Xuan's final testament: "Heaven's fate is about to change, the eye within the eye is already watching. The true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in the past, not in the present, but in -" The text ended abruptly, as if severed by some force. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. "The eye within the eye"? What was that? What relation did it have to Heaven's Mandate's Eye? New mysteries had just emerged, and outside the ruins, Han Lie was departing with humiliation and hatred. Would he simply let this matter rest? When would Xuanwu Sect's retaliation come? And that Ling Yuan who always hid in the shadows - what was he scheming?
